findings.text: the plan-summary meta still describes the superseded design ('retries a failure whose message names a held index.lock for a bounded window ... a failure that names no lock, and a lock that outlasts the window, refuse as before'), contradicting the body above it and the landed code at reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2222, so the record's headline misdescribes what shipped to a reader who does not open the file.

the log's revision line names 'WORKTREE HEAD (83274eee8)', a sha at which _run_waiting_out_a_held_index_lock does not exist, and the same wrong stamp sits on lint.log:1, so a reader checking out the named revision cannot reproduce either log; the logs were taken against the post-refactor working tree and should name 29525ad5a.

the assertion compares the recorded per-entry attempt numbers against list(range(1, len(retries) + 1)) derived from the same list it reads, so it is not independent of the value under test; it guards 1-based sequential numbering only.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits gained since the prior review; 29525ad5a deletes the staging's private loop and _staging_names_a_held_index_lock and adds reckon/crew/merge.py:353 for both callers, and 3bcd48bc4 updates the fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_landing_write_waits_out_a_held_index_lock.py; final-gate.log records 1 failed/185 passed EXIT=1 and baseline-suite.log 1 failed/182 passed EXIT=1 with the same environmental failure in both, negative-control.log records the declared first case red at EXIT=1, and a re-run of the file at the reviewed head gave 3 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to make the landing staging retry a held index.lock on a bound and record each retry; reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2222 _stage_landing_writes calls reckon/crew/merge.py:353 _run_waiting_out_a_held_index_lock for its git add, which retries while the checkout holds index.lock and calls on_retry before each wait.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, commits afb0bd244..3bcd48bc4, the two-arm gate 1 failed/182 vs 1 failed/185, the negative control at EXIT=1, lint.log, and measurement_module/measurement_cwd for the base arm.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the dispatch fenced promotion_scope.py, merge.py, the test file, the fragment and two importing tests; the diff 83274eee8..3bcd48bc4 touches only promotion_scope.py, merge.py, tests/test_a_landing_write_waits_out_a_held_index_lock.py and the fragment, all inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_landing_write_waits_out_a_held_index_lock.py:120 asserts result['committed'] is True, which negative-control.log shows reddens when the retry is removed, but :165 compares the recorded attempt list against a range built from that same list.
justifications.evidence: final-gate.log and baseline-suite.log record 1 failed/185 passed vs 1 failed/182 passed with the one failure environmental in both arms, and the focused file re-run at the reviewed head passed 3/3 EXIT=0, but negative-control.log:1 and lint.log:1 stamp revision 83274eee8 while exercising code that exists only from 29525ad5a, so their stated revision does not reproduce them.
justifications.fit: the added names are mechanism-named and promotion_scope.py:2413 follows the file's pre-existing bottom import block, though ruff format --check reports six constructs at reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:1217 that the parent commit 83274eee8 had cleaned, so head no longer passes the check its parent passed even though the delta against the run's base is zero.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2222 _stage_landing_writes retries its git add through the shared helper and records each retry via on_retry, which is what the goal asks, though detection moved from the message to the checkout's own index.lock, a change the prior review requested.
justifications.reuse: the duplicate _staging_names_a_held_index_lock and its private loop are deleted and reckon/crew/merge.py:353 gains the one helper both land_merge and _stage_landing_writes call, extending the owner merge.py already had at _index_lock_held:350.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff 83274eee8..3bcd48bc4 changes only reckon/crew/merge.py, reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py, tests/test_a_landing_write_waits_out_a_held_index_lock.py and the fragment, every one inside the dispatch's declared write paths.
